0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000010_TATARU
0.description: Look how many people there are!

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000020_TATARU
1.description: Should we get to it, then? Pick up anything that seems the least bit “device” like, and we'll make ourselves a pile.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000030_BIGGS
2.description: Well if it isn't the hero of the hour! Maybe you'll change our luck─we've found bugger all without you.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000050_BIGGS
4.description: Aye, aye, well we could hardly say no to a call for aid from the Scions.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000060_BIGGS
5.description: Jessie collared the chief for some other business, so we'll be working twice as hard to make up for his not being here.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000080_TATARU
7.description: Thank you─both of you! I'm sure we'll find that beacon in no time!

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000090_BIGGS
8.description: Hm. I'm not seeing anything out here.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000100_BIGGS
9.description: D'you reckon you could squeeze in there, Wedge?

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000110_WEDGE
10.description: And get stuck halfway!? No thank you.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000120_TATARU
11.description: I could try if you like!

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000130_WEDGE
12.description: Tataru, no! We couldn't ask you to do that!

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000140_TATARU
13.description: Oh, I'll be fine! This receptionist is not afraid to get her hands dirty!

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000150_BIGGS
14.description: Sorry, I-I meant to say─the scholars haven't finished their preliminary assessment of the site yet, so we're not supposed to venture too far in.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000230_MYSTERYVOICE
22.description: Stay with me! Focus on my voice!

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000240_MYSTERYVOICE
23.description: Let expanse contract, eon become instant...

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000250_TATARU
24.description: ...Wait, this must be it! The device! This is <hex:021A020203>supposed<hex:021A020103> to happen!

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000260_MYSTERYVOICE
25.description: Throw wide the gates that we may pass!

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000270_TATARU
26.description: Safe journey, Warrior of Light. Find our friends, and bring them home!

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000280_MINFILIA
28.description: Your time has not yet come.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000300_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
30.description: Something vague...yet urgent...calls me to action once more.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000310_PEDDLEROFNORVRANDT
31.description: Rare to meet someone out here who's not a peddler themself. What brings you into the wilds this time o' night?

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
33.description: What do you mean, “this time of night”?

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000330_PEDDLEROFNORVRANDT
36.description: Well, if it ain't the oldest joke in the book. Me grandad─gods rest his soul─used to tell that one to the barman at kickin'-out time.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000340_PEDDLEROFNORVRANDT
37.description: "An' when, pray tell, did we last have a dark night? Ye rotten old drunk ye!“ he'd reply.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000350_PEDDLEROFNORVRANDT
39.description: "Over a hundred bleedin' years ago, that's when!“

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000360_PEDDLEROFNORVRANDT
40.description: Hm! You've got that look down to a tee. I'd almost think you meant it...

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000370_PEDDLEROFNORVRANDT
41.description: Ahhh, got to you, did they? Poor beggar. That explains it, then.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000380_PEDDLEROFNORVRANDT
43.description: Well, I've roads to travel and wares to sell, but you─you'd best hurry along to the town nearby.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000390_PEDDLEROFNORVRANDT
44.description: Just head east through the trees, and aim for the shining tower. You'll find the place soon enough. 'Tis the biggest settlement for malms around.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000400_PEDDLEROFNORVRANDT
45.description: Go on, now, friend. They'll take good care of you in the Crystarium.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000410_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
46.description: To dizzying heights it rises, the gleaming spire, its tip threatening to pierce the blinding canopy.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000420_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
47.description: There it will all begin anew. Between Dark and Light, the pure and the corrupt─the one true struggle...

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000440_LYNA
49.description: (-Curt Gateguard-)Every face in this city I know. Yours I do not.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000450_LYNA
50.description: (-Curt Gateguard-)This is the threshold of the Crystarium, stranger, and I am its gatekeeper. If you would enter, you will answer my questions.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000470_LYNA
58.description: (-Curt Gateguard-)Do you take me for a fool? No such place exists.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000480_LYNA
59.description: (-Curt Gateguard-)"The Source“? What is this cryptic nonsense?

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000490_LYNA
60.description: (-Curt Gateguard-)You will not say? Then I have even less reason to trust you.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000500_LYNA
61.description: (-Curt Gateguard-)Had you given me an honest answer, I would not have barred your way─we care little here for a person's place of origin. But instead you chose concealment, and I will not suffer you to pass...

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000510_LYNA
63.description: (-Curt Gateguard-)That one had eaten. It must have gulped down the whole hand, ring and all...

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000530_LYNA
65.description: (-Curt Gateguard-)Quite all right, my lord. Just a stray sin eater, and a weak one at that.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000540_MYSTERYVOICE
66.description: I see. Weak or not, we should be on the lookout for more.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000550_MYSTERYVOICE
67.description: But I see you've met my guest. I will escort <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> to the Crystarium myself...if you've no objections?

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000560_LYNA
68.description: (-Curt Gateguard-)Another of your mysterious friends, is it? I should have known.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000570_LYNA
69.description: (-Curt Gateguard-)Very well. I'll inform the others your guest is to be given the run of the city.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000580_LYNA
70.description: (-Curt Gateguard-)Pray forgive my less-than-cordial welcome. May the rest of your stay with us be a pleasant one.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000590_MYSTERYVOICE
71.description: Come with me. I will answer whatever questions you have when we are somewhere more private.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000600_MYSTERYVOICE
72.description: Right, then. Before we plunge into the wheres and wherefores, let me first thank you for answering my summons.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000610_MYSTERYVOICE
73.description: I had intended to bring you directly to my personal quarters, but I fear my aim was...slightly off. That you were still able to make the crossing unharmed is...a great relief.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000620_MYSTERYVOICE
74.description: And so we come to the question of where. The realm in which you now find yourself belongs to one of the thirteen reflections or shards─the First, to be precise─even if its inhabitants are largely oblivious to the fact.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000630_MYSTERYVOICE
75.description: As to wherefore... Having been awarded the rather grandiose title of “Crystal Exarch,” I─in my capacity as caretaker of the Crystarium─thought to seek the aid of you and your companions.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
78.description: Do you have any idea how much trouble you've caused?

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000640_MYSTERYVOICE
79.description: Ah. That...is a question with no simple answer. But all shall be explained in due course, I promise you.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000650_MYSTERYVOICE
80.description: ...An inkling, yes. I can only beg your forgiveness─matters here forced my hand. But all shall be explained in due course, I promise you.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000660_MYSTERYVOICE
81.description: Let us begin with the glaring skies up above.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000670_MYSTERYVOICE
82.description: Here in the First, the world has been all but consumed by primordial Light.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000680_MYSTERYVOICE
83.description: It began a century ago, by this realm's reckoning. A luminous flood swallowing everything in its path. More than nine-tenths of this star was lost.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000690_MYSTERYVOICE
84.description: And the fortunate few who survived are hounded by abominations born of that catastrophe even now.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000700_MYSTERYVOICE
85.description: "Sin eaters,“ we call them. The creature you saw earlier was one such monstrosity.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000710_MYSTERYVOICE
86.description: It was to save the First from this menace that I learned to bridge the rift between worlds─that I might call upon the aid of the greatest of heroes.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000720_MYSTERYVOICE
87.description: Though it meant depriving a world of its champion, I had to try─for in saving the First, you would bring salvation to the Source as well.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000730_MYSTERYVOICE
88.description: But what manner of host harangues his guest in the middle of the road? Let us continue our talk within the Crystarium.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000740_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
89.description: Such a proud and vibrant city...

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000750_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
90.description: The sole sanctuary for the living in a world all but resigned to oblivion.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000760_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
91.description: Each stone was laid with hope; the town itself a symbol, a monument to defiance in the face of death.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000770_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
92.description: No would-be hero could fail to answer its call. For who among us does not yearn for salvation?

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000780_MYSTERYVOICE
93.description: Welcome to the Ocular, my private study. We can speak here without fear of being overheard.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000790_MYSTERYVOICE
94.description: I have much to explain, but the truths which I must touch upon in doing so would cause only distress and confusion to the people of this world. Pray keep that in mind.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000800_MYSTERYVOICE
95.description: Now, I am sure you are desperate to know the fate of your fellow Scions.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000810_MYSTERYVOICE
96.description: To put it simply, they are here in the First...

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000820_MYSTERYVOICE
97.description: Their arrival, however, was not as recent as you may imagine. Here, time flows at a different pace from that of the Source.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000830_MYSTERYVOICE
98.description: In the space of a single hour in your home world, an entire year might pass in the First─and the reverse could also be true. The pace fluctuates without rhyme or reason, and it cannot be predicted.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000840_MYSTERYVOICE
99.description: That said, we seem to be entering a period of near-equivalence, and thus, for the moment, you need not overly concern yourself with the passage of time.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000850_MYSTERYVOICE
100.description: As for your companions, however... Y'shtola and Urianger have dwelled here for three winters all told, while Thancred's count stands at five.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000860_MYSTERYVOICE
101.description: Even our more “recent” arrivals, Alphinaud and Alisaie, have lived in the First for almost a year.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000870_MYSTERYVOICE
102.description: My intention had been to summon only you, but the art of reaching across worlds has proven exceedingly difficult to master. Thus it was that my <hex:021A020203>fumbling<hex:021A020103> hand closed upon those to whom your fate is most closely bound as well.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000880_MYSTERYVOICE
103.description: As they were not the object of my summons...their transference was...incomplete. Though they may appear to possess corporeal bodies, they are, in truth, merely spirits that one can see and touch.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000890_MYSTERYVOICE
104.description: Consequently, while you yourself will be able to pass between worlds with relative freedom, they will not. Much as it grieves me...they are stranded here, unable to return.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
106.description: Then find a way to send them back.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
107.description: What have they been doing all this time?

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000900_MYSTERYVOICE
108.description: We spent every waking hour searching for a way to reverse the summoning. In the beginning, at least...

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000910_MYSTERYVOICE
109.description: As you may have surmised, however, our efforts met with little success. And then we all but abandoned the endeavor once Urianger shared with us the vision he had witnessed during his journey through the rift.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000920_MYSTERYVOICE
110.description: In that chaotic no-man's-land between realms, time and space warp and blend in...unexpected ways. What Urianger saw...was the future. That which would one day come to pass.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000930_MYSTERYVOICE
111.description: In his vision of tomorrow, the First was rejoined with the Source...

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000940_MYSTERYVOICE
112.description: This collision of worlds brought about the Eighth Umbral Calamity, and the deaths of countless multitudes.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000950_MYSTERYVOICE
113.description: Amongst those who perished, Urianger clearly saw the fall of the Scions' mightiest champion. He watched you die.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000960_MYSTERYVOICE
114.description: And thus did the Scions embrace their exile, and began searching this world for a means to forestall the coming catastrophe in yours.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000970_MYSTERYVOICE
115.description: Their souls are stranded in the First, yes, but they have fought on, desperate to save their home─and you─from destruction.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000980_MYSTERYVOICE
116.description: Nor have their efforts been in vain: for it was they who finally established that the elimination of the sin eaters will indeed serve to prevent the calamity.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_000990_MYSTERYVOICE
117.description: Considering the...circumstances of our meeting, you would be forgiven for doubting my version of events.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001000_MYSTERYVOICE
118.description: And so, before all else, I would suggest you track down your comrades, and hear the tale from their lips.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001010_MYSTERYVOICE
119.description: I shall, of course, be happy to assist in these reunions─and you need not make any decisions regarding your involvement until you are certain of where you stand.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001020_MYSTERYVOICE
120.description: Meanwhile, I promise I will not rest until I have found a way to help your friends return home.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001030_MYSTERYVOICE
121.description: What say you? Have I earned your trust for the moment, at least?

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
124.description: Aye, but I'll see you keep that promise.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_A5_000_003_NONE_VOICE
125.description: For want of a better choice...

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001040_MYSTERYVOICE
126.description: Excellent. You will not regret this.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001050_MYSTERYVOICE
127.description: With that settled, we shall have to see about getting you ready for the road.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001060_MYSTERYVOICE
128.description: Traveling across the rift has no doubt left you weary─I will arrange for a room where you might rest in comfort. While it's being prepared, perhaps I can show you around?

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001070_MYSTERYVOICE
129.description: This is the Musica Universalis, the commercial heart of the Crystarium. Aught you might need to prepare for your journeys can be purchased here.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001080_MYSTERYVOICE
130.description: Ah, yes─you must be curious about the currency. Fear not! The gil you carry will serve you well enough.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001090_MYSTERYVOICE
131.description: Each nation once minted its own coins, but 'twas all a jumbled mess following the Flood.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001100_MYSTERYVOICE
132.description: After much debate, the local merchants eventually elected to revert to the old ways, wherein a coin's value was decided by the worth of its metal.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001110_MYSTERYVOICE
133.description: As for a unit of measurement, we agreed upon the term “gil.” A word borrowed from coins uncovered within the Crystal Tower here.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001120_MYSTERYVOICE
134.description: And as our traders peddled their wares across the land, so too did our usage of gil become common practice.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001130_MYSTERYVOICE
135.description: From what Y'shtola tells me, a standard coin from the Source equates to exactly one gil here─or near enough not to matter.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001140_MYSTERYVOICE
136.description: Our way of life has benefited greatly from the artifacts we recovered from the tower...

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001150_MYSTERYVOICE
137.description: ...Some of which may be familiar to you.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001160_MYSTERYVOICE
138.description: But I fear it would not be practical for us to provide <hex:021A020203>everything<hex:021A020103> to which you are accustomed. You shall need a means to access the commodities of your home world...

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001180_FEOUL
140.description: (-???-)Yes, I'm here, of course I'm here! What amusements do you have for me today?

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001190_MYSTERYVOICE
141.description: My dear Feo Ul, paragon of pixie-kind. For you, I have the most vital task.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001200_MYSTERYVOICE
142.description: This fine gentleman is a friend from a distant realm.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001210_MYSTERYVOICE
143.description: This fine lady is a friend from a distant realm.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001220_MYSTERYVOICE
144.description: And we have need of a means to ferry things back and forth from <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> home. Might you be able to...assist us in this matter?

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001230_FEOUL
145.description: You came from beyond, didn't you!? From beyond the rift!

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001240_FEOUL
146.description: How wonderfully exciting! What a brave and reckless and marvelous thing you did! You've the heart of a pixie, you do!

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001250_FEOUL
147.description: After careful consideration, I have decided to grant you my assistance. Make a pact with me, and the fun can begin!

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001260_FEOUL
148.description: But answer me this, traveler: did your garments come with you when you crossed over? Your teeth? Your nails?

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001270_FEOUL
149.description: Just as I thought! Then you've a good, stout connection with your home, through which all your belongings great and small may easily pass.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001280_FEOUL
150.description: From this moment forth, I will be your [beautiful branch], and you my [adorable sapling]. Like the branch which sprouts from the sapling, our bond will flow unbroken from one to the other!

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001300_FEOUL
152.description: 'Tis done! We are bound now, dearest sapling.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001310_FEOUL
153.description: Come, come, then! Make your request! Tell me your desire! I wish to visit this world of yours!

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001320_MYSTERYVOICE
154.description: Mayhap a message to your friends in the Source to inform them of your safe arrival?

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001340_MYSTERYVOICE
159.description: As you heard, that was Feo Ul of the pixies. Their kind possess an affinity for magic akin to that of arcane beings.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001350_MYSTERYVOICE
160.description: They rarely show themselves in populated areas, but Feo is insatiably curious even by pixie standards, and seems to have taken a liking to the Crystarium.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001360_MYSTERYVOICE
161.description: Right, we were going to organize a room for you, weren't we? Come along.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001390_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
164.description: (-???-)I know you... You're the Warrior of Light from the Source!

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001400_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
168.description: (-???-)What? Did you just... You can hear me!?

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001410_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
169.description: (-???-)Oh, gods, how long has it been...?

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001420_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
170.description: (-???-)...Aye...aye, that was what I called myself in your world... The “Warrior of Darkness.”

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001430_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
171.description: My real name is Ardbert. I used an alias in the Source. A daft one, looking back...

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001440_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
172.description: (-???-)...“And who are you?” <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> says. An enemy not worth remembering, apparently...

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001450_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
173.description: My name is Ardbert. In the First, I was a Warrior of Light, but in the Source you knew me as the Warrior of Darkness.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001460_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
174.description: If you recall my tale, it was my comrades and I who caused the Flood.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001470_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
175.description: We thought our home doomed. And so we listened to the Ascians─let them guide us to the Source, and tried to hasten their godsdamned Ardor.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001480_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
176.description: I remember when we fell, defeated by you and yours. I remember our audience with Minfilia─how she listened to our pleas, and returned our souls to the First.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001490_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
177.description: The Flood was poised to swallow Norvrandt...

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001500_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
178.description: Minfilia and my friends, they...they surrendered what little they had left to hold it back. Just faded away...leaving me to bear witness.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001510_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
179.description: Tell me, do you know the year? How much time has passed since we caused the Flood?

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001520_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
180.description: A hundred years... A hundred long years...

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001530_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
181.description: My hands find no purchase. My gestures catch no eye. And my pleas, be they whispered or screamed, reach not a single ear...

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001540_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
182.description: I am a shade, cursed to do naught but drift.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001550_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
183.description: I feel as if I've been walking forever... I hardly noticed when my mind and body began to fray at the edges.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001560_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
184.description: Then “bang,” my senses were sharp again. I felt like a fish being reeled in, and before I knew it, I found myself in this room.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001570_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
185.description: Why is it that <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> can see me? What are you even doing here, come to that?

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001580_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
186.description: You were summoned to save the First?

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001590_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
187.description: A waste of time. This world is beyond saving─like those who try to save it.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001600_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
188.description: Muddled as my mind may be, I've not forgotten that.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001610_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
189.description: But if fate has brought me to you─the one person in this godsforsaken world who can see and hear me─then perhaps there is a reason I endured.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001620_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
190.description: If I can find out why I was left behind, then maybe...maybe I can bring this journey of mine to an end...

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001630_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
191.description: Well. I'll be watching, Warrior of Light.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001640_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
192.description: But do me a favor. Be careful out there. This world has had its fill of heroes.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001650_MYSTERYVOICE
193.description: Ah, how did you find your new quarters? I trust you were able to rest?

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001660_MYSTERYVOICE
197.description: That is good to hear. Should you want for anything, pray let me know.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001670_MYSTERYVOICE
198.description: I...was not aware the room was haunted. And...you <hex:021A020203>were<hex:021A020103> rather tired... Well, should you receive another visitation, be sure to let me know.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001680_MYSTERYVOICE
199.description: Now, let us return to the subject of the Scions' whereabouts.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001690_MYSTERYVOICE
200.description: This map shows the lands of Norvrandt, the only area to be spared the Flood of Light.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001700_MYSTERYVOICE
201.description: The Crystarium is here, in the region known as Lakeland.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001710_MYSTERYVOICE
202.description: To the north is the faerie kingdom of Il Mheg. That is where you will find Urianger.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001720_MYSTERYVOICE
203.description: To the east lies the once-prosperous civilization of Rak'tika. Y'shtola is stationed there, in the heart of the forest.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001730_MYSTERYVOICE
204.description: Alas, neither location can be reached without considerable difficulty.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001740_MYSTERYVOICE
205.description: As such, I would suggest you first seek out one of the twins─each of whom is stationed but a short flight from the Crystarium.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001750_MYSTERYVOICE
206.description: Alphinaud is on Kholusia, an island off the western shore. It is home to a city called Eulmore, where the rich and privileged while away their days in idleness.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001760_MYSTERYVOICE
207.description: For his part in furthering our cause, Alphinaud journeyed there to meet with the citizenry and forge alliances. From what I hear, he has since kept himself busy gathering information around the main settlement.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001770_MYSTERYVOICE
208.description: Alisaie, meanwhile, traveled south to the arid wastes of Amh Araeng.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001780_MYSTERYVOICE
209.description: They lie upon the very edge of the inhabitable world, where the Flood of Light was halted. Those who dwell there live in constant fear of attack by the sin eaters.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001790_MYSTERYVOICE
210.description: In contrast to her brother, Alisaie felt that her energies would better be spent learning about the enemy. And thus she sells her services as a guard, both to hone her skills and gather information on our foe.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001800_MYSTERYVOICE
211.description: So, will it be Kholusia or Amh Araeng? It matters not which you choose to visit first.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001810_MYSTERYVOICE
212.description: Simply inform me once you have made your decision, and I will see to it that you are provided with a suitable mount.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001820_MYSTERYVOICE
213.description: Ah, but you must be wondering about Thancred. He has taken up with...a new companion, and is presently engaged as a wandering hunter of sin eaters.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001830_MYSTERYVOICE
214.description: Being ever on the move, his whereabouts are often difficult to ascertain, but I am certain your paths will cross ere long.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001840_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
215.description: The whistling breeze, mute. The pounding surf, frozen. Time itself takes a breath...

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001850_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
216.description: At Light's edge, all is perfectly still. The world captured in a painting; locked in a moment.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001860_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
217.description: Music, faint and fleeting, drifts coastward on the lifeless air...

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001870_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
218.description: And in the distance, beyond the broken earth, a city beckons...

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001880_ALPHINAUD
219.description: (-???-)And how is business today, Mistress Theva?

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001890_THEVA
220.description: Oh, frenetic. Look. I have a new customer.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001900_ALPHINAUD
221.description: ...'Tis good to see you, my friend.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001910_ALPHINAUD
222.description: The barley seeds you wanted. They should produce a better harvest than the last.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001920_THEVA
223.description: What, just like that? Oh, Alphinaud, you really are a dear.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001930_THEVA
224.description: Well, I'd best be tidying up some of those empty shacks before the pests move in. Keep an eye on the place while I'm out, eh?

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001940_ALPHINAUD
225.description: It seems an age since last we spoke. Not since the prisoner exchange in Doma. And Yotsuyu...

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001950_ALPHINAUD
226.description: It has been even longer for me, of course, if you count the days I have spent here. But the time has only added to the relief I feel, seeing you safe and well.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_A9_000_001_NONE_VOICE
228.description: Me? I was more worried about you.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001960_ALPHINAUD
230.description: Hah! Alisaie said much the same thing. I don't think I've ever had such a scolding.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001970_ALPHINAUD
231.description: But I believe an exchange of news is in order. Come─tell me of your arrival, and all that came before!

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001980_ALPHINAUD
232.description: I see. Both the Exarch and Alisaie told me what they knew of events, but I had stubbornly clung on to the hope that all-out war might yet be avoidable...

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001990_ALPHINAUD
233.description: And poor Tataru─she must be sick with worry. We must endeavor to return as soon as we may...

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_001991_ALPHINAUD
234.description: 'Twould be nice to bring her good tidings for a change.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002000_ALPHINAUD
235.description: But before we bid this world farewell, we must first ensure that it is not rejoined to the Source. We must prevent the Eighth Umbral Calamity.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002010_ALPHINAUD
236.description: Urianger's vision of the future has, I fear, every chance of coming true.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002020_ALPHINAUD
237.description: By his description, the catalyst for the Calamity was a formless and deadly weapon employed by the Garlean Empire.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002030_ALPHINAUD
238.description: Which can only mean one thing: Black Rose. Gaius was telling you the truth. When we were on the trail of the Ascians, we saw evidence that the gas was being manufactured once more.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002040_ALPHINAUD
239.description: Gaius was adamant that the project had been scrapped. But so long as there are wars to be waged, there will always be those determined to win by any means.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002050_ALPHINAUD
240.description: And thus simply destroying the existing stores of Black Rose would do little to alter fate's course.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002060_ALPHINAUD
241.description: In that sense, our involuntary journey here to the First was something of a boon.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002070_ALPHINAUD
242.description: Together with the Exarch, we've developed a theory as to how we believe the Rejoining will be set in motion.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002080_ALPHINAUD
243.description: I am sure Urianger himself will cover the subject in more detail...

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002090_ALPHINAUD
244.description: But I can tell you the process requires that both worlds─the Source and the First─be facing an existential threat.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002100_ALPHINAUD
245.description: One being sin eaters, of course.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002110_ALPHINAUD
246.description: They are a menace that I would dearly love to remove, and not just to avert a calamity.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002120_ALPHINAUD
247.description: I may be a stranger to this world, but I will not stand idly by and let innocent people be slaughtered.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002130_ALPHINAUD
248.description: That is what brought me to the gates of Eulmore. Ignoring its pretentions as a kind of capital city to what remains of the world, it is nonetheless a center of power and authority.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002140_ALPHINAUD
249.description: If any solutions are to be found, I believe our search should begin there. What say you, old friend? Hungry for another adventure?

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002150_ALPHINAUD
250.description: And so we take to the road once more!

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002160_ALPHINAUD
251.description: That gate up ahead is known as the “Open Arms,” and Eulmore itself lies beyond.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002170_ALPHINAUD
252.description: This, meanwhile, is the aptly named “Gatetown.” The dwelling place of the many desperate souls who hope to be chosen to live in the city proper.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002180_GATETOWNMIDDLEAGE
253.description: Oh! I thought I recognized you. Brought a new friend, eh?

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002190_GATETOWNMIDDLEAGE
254.description: Heh heh heh heh... I'll bet you've got a trick or two up your sleeve. Maybe even <hex:021A020203>three<hex:021A020103>! Care to show me?

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002200_ALPHINAUD
255.description: He's not here to compete. Leave him be.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002210_ALPHINAUD
256.description: She's not here to compete. Leave her be.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002220_GATETOWNMIDDLEAGE
257.description: What!? I was only making conversation!

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002240_CLOWNOFRED
259.description: Greetings to our hopeful petitioners, one and all! Eulmore extends its warmest regards!

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002250_CLOWNOFRED
260.description: Let it be known that a lady of distinction wishes to dine on fish divine!

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002260_CLOWNOFBLUE
261.description: We seek a master culinarian who can guarantee seafood perfection! Dazzle the matron with your delicious dishes, and life in the city will be yours to enjoy. Even on days when fish is not on the menu!

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002270_CLOWNOFRED
262.description: Who among you will answer the call? Name yourself or another, we mind not at all!

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002310_ALPHINAUD
266.description: Do you recall how I said Eulmore was a center of power and authority? Well, that is not the only reason for its fame.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002320_ALPHINAUD
267.description: It is also known as the “city of final pleasures.” The noble and the wealthy who survived the Flood gathered here to live out the rest of their days in decadent abandon.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002330_ALPHINAUD
268.description: A poor man could sooner pass through the eye of a needle than Eulmore's gates. The only way the commonfolk can enter this perverted paradise is if they fulfill the whim of one of the privileged. And so they are picked over like market produce...

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002340_CLOWNOFRED
269.description: Ohoho! What a catch! We'll not be throwing this one back!

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002350_CLOWNOFRED
270.description: Having seen your all-too-obvious charms, we welcome you with open arms! Come, join us in the city of splendor, and live out your life in an ecstasy of endeavor!

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002360_CLOWNOFBLUE
271.description: Ah, just look at those expectant faces! What could you <hex:021A020203>possibly<hex:021A020103> be waiting for!?

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002370_CLOWNOFBLUE
272.description: Well, well, what have we here!? An extra share of meol to celebrate our newest resident!

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002400_ALPHINAUD
278.description: “Meol” is a foodstuff which Eulmore routinely doles out to the people of Gatetown, and apparently a staple for its citizens as well.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002410_ALPHINAUD
279.description: Many here rely on it to survive in these times of scarcity. Yet the whole arrangement just seems...

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002411_ALPHINAUD
280.description: Well, let us just say it leaves a bad taste in my mouth.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002430_ALPHINAUD
282.description: The thief who claimed the harvest on <hex:021A020203>my<hex:021A020103> behalf. Hand it over.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002450_KAISHIRR
284.description: (-Blue-haired Mystel-)Forgive me, I just─ I have to get into the city!

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002460_KAISHIRR
285.description: (-Blue-haired Mystel-)I have no family, and all my friends have already been chosen.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002470_KAISHIRR
286.description: (-Blue-haired Mystel-)No one here gives a damn about me. When the meol gets handed out, I'm lucky if I get a smell of it!

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002480_KAISHIRR
287.description: (-Blue-haired Mystel-)No matter what I do, they won't call out my name! I'm so tired─I'm so <hex:021A020203>bloody<hex:021A020103> hungry...

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002490_KAISHIRR
288.description: (-Blue-haired Mystel-)I thought maybe I could steal your idea─get in that way...

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002520_ALPHINAUD
291.description: Tell me then, Kai-Shirr─must it be Eulmore or nothing?

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002530_ALPHINAUD
292.description: What of the Crystarium? They may not offer charity, but you would be fairly compensated for any work you did.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002540_KAISHIRR
293.description: No, no, it has to be Eulmore!

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002550_KAISHIRR
294.description: That's where all my friends are. We made a promise that we'd live together in paradise...

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002560_ALPHINAUD
295.description: ...I was to make my deal with the Ondo at the Clave. Listen carefully, and I shall tell you my plans for the business, and how best to arouse the Eulmorans' interest.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002570_KAISHIRR
296.description: You'll give me your place? Just like that?

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002580_ALPHINAUD
297.description: I'm giving you a chance, nothing more. What comes of it is entirely up to you.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002590_KAISHIRR
298.description: ...I understand! Oh thank you, thank you!

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002600_ALPHINAUD
299.description: This was but one path─there will be others. But for young Kai-Shirr, it was the difference between life and death.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002610_ALPHINAUD
300.description: I do not regret my decision...yet I will admit that a part of me wonders if it was for the best.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002620_ALPHINAUD
301.description: We strive to bring swift salvation to this world, that countless lives might be saved─not least your own. Even if it came at the cost of one man, should I have forged on regardless...?

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_A10_000_002_NONE_VOICE
304.description: Quite possibly. Meaning we'd better hurry up and think of a new plan.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002630_ALPHINAUD
305.description: I suppose not... Were Estinien here, he would most likely scoff at my soft-heartedness. “Same old Alphinaud. Ever the slave to sentiment.”

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002640_ALPHINAUD
306.description: But I thank you for your kind words, nonetheless. Let us see to it that both these stories have a happy ending.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002650_ALPHINAUD
307.description: Indeed. We will find another way, I promise you.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002660_ALPHINAUD
308.description: Shall we return to Wright, then?

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002680_ALPHINAUD
310.description: I can't be sure, but I-I think someone's in trouble!

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002690_ALPHINAUD
311.description: Come on, they may need our help!

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002710_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
313.description: The lament of all but saints and fools...and the comfort of the lords and ladies of this accursed place.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002720_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
314.description: Once, they held fast against the madness, only to embrace the coming cataclysm and delight in the end of days.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002730_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
315.description: Perhaps in rapture they seek to lose themselves and the misery they share...

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002740_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
316.description: Or perhaps for them alone the promise of eternal pleasure really does hold true.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002760_ALPHINAUD
318.description: Lord and Lady Chai, pray forgive our intrusion. I am given to understand you were in search...of an <hex:021A020203>artist<hex:021A020103>?

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002770_CHAINUZZ
319.description: Ahh, you must be the new, uh...

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002780_DULIACHAI
320.description: Oh, goodness me! What an adorable boy!

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002790_DULIACHAI
321.description: That silken hair, those pearly cheeks...oh, and you even smell wonderful─like a bed of flowers!

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002800_DULIACHAI
322.description: I approve of this one, dearest! I am <hex:021A020203>positive<hex:021A020103> he will paint us the most delightful pictures.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002810_CHAINUZZ
323.description: I, um, er, y-yes... Ahem. Well, as long as he paints better than that talentless wretch we sent packing last week...

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002820_DULIACHAI
324.description: Wonderful, wonderful! Welcome to Eulmore...um, er...

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002830_ALPHINAUD
325.description: Alphinaud, if it please you, my lady. And this...is my assistant.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002840_CHAINUZZ
326.description: Your...assistant? I've heard of folk bringing in family members, but this seems a bit irregular. Aren't you a little young to have a protégé?

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002850_ALPHINAUD
327.description: We are family in all but name, my lord. Though we share no blood, we have stood by each other through life's many challenges, resolved to prevail together─or not at all.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002860_ALPHINAUD
328.description: Of all people, 'tis he who best understands my work. With his unique insight guiding my hand, the art I create is sure to satisfy your expectations.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002870_ALPHINAUD
329.description: Of all people, 'tis she who best understands my work. With her unique insight guiding my hand, the art I create is sure to satisfy your expectations.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002880_ALPHINAUD
330.description: Once the picture is begun, of course, I shall have no need of constant encouragement.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002890_ALPHINAUD
331.description: And so I wondered, rather than <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> being in your way, might it then be permissible for my assistant to explore the city <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> has so longed to see?

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002900_ALPHINAUD
332.description: Out of gratitude for <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> <hex:021A020203>priceless<hex:021A020103> contribution to my art, I thought it only fair that I make this humble request on <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> behalf.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002910_DULIACHAI
333.description: Oooh, did you ever hear of such devotion! Of <hex:021A020203>course<hex:021A020103> your assistant must have <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> wish! <hex:02080CE905FF04536865FF03486503> shall be free to roam to <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> heart's content!

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002930_CHAINUZZ
335.description: Uh... Oh, yes. Yes, of course, dearest. Q-Quite right.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002950_ALPHINAUD
337.description: He is attended by sin eaters...? But how does he keep them from attacking?

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_002990_VAUTHRY
341.description: Who are these impudent louts? I do not recall requesting their presence.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003000_ALPHINAUD
342.description: Lord Vauthry! What is the meaning of this? Why is this poor man bleeding to death on your floor!?

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003010_VAUTHRY
343.description: Why? You ask me why? Because criminals must be punished, and this man is guilty of fraud.

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003020_VAUTHRY
344.description: He came to us claiming to be a man of business, yet his subsequent conduct has shown him to be anything but!

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003030_VAUTHRY
345.description: Eulmore is a city built on love for one's fellow man. Those who have naught to give and live only to take are a blight upon our society!

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003040_VAUTHRY
346.description: To atone for this crime, I ordered that he fling himself from the balcony.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003050_VAUTHRY
347.description: And he had the <hex:021A020203>temerity<hex:021A020103> to weep! “Please, my lord! Anything but that!”

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003060_VAUTHRY
348.description: What then is a man of mercy to do, but offer the sinner another way to show his contrition?

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003080_VAUTHRY
350.description: Sin eaters are part of Eulmore's society. But they must be fed with aether─<hex:021A020203>living<hex:021A020103> aether.

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003090_VAUTHRY
351.description: So─I demanded an offering of flesh! Carved by his own hand, from his own hide!

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003100_VAUTHRY
352.description: And still! <hex:021A020203>Still<hex:021A020103>, he could not do as I asked!

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003120_ALPHINAUD
354.description: 'Tis true that Kai-Shirr won his place here by fraud. But his actions were driven only by a desire to share in your paradise.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003130_ALPHINAUD
355.description: That you would cast him out I could almost accept, but to humiliate him thus? To demand his very <hex:021A020203>life<hex:021A020103>!? Is this truly the way of Eulmore!?

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003140_VAUTHRY
356.description: Oh, you dim, deluded child... Have you ever paused to consider what it takes to maintain such a paradise in this barren, broken world of ours?

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003150_VAUTHRY
357.description: The guarantee of safety and stability. The knowledge that if one only abides by the rules, one has naught to fear.

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003160_VAUTHRY
358.description: I alone can offer these things, for I alone can command the sin eaters.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003170_VAUTHRY
359.description: And thus am I alone the voice of justice─and any who oppose me villains to be punished!

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003190_VAUTHRY
361.description: <hex:021A020203>You<hex:021A020103> were granted a place in my city for a particular skill. What was it?

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003210_VAUTHRY
363.description: Oho, an artiste! Then you shall paint a picture for me. Of Eulmore.

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003220_VAUTHRY
364.description: If I find your art <hex:021A020203>pleasing<hex:021A020103>, then I may excuse this display of insolence.

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003230_VAUTHRY
365.description: Who gave you permission to tend to that criminal's wounds!? I told you to paint me a picture!

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003240_ALPHINAUD
366.description: What you need is a mirror, not a painting. It will capture the horror I see before me far better than I ever could.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003270_VAUTHRY
369.description: Did...did that little worm just insult me?

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003290_VAUTHRY
371.description: I─I─I'll kill them! I'll─I'll kill them all!

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003300_VAUTHRY
372.description: I'll enslave their minds! I'll─I'll torment them─torture them! Then tear out their hearts!

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003310_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
373.description: Amh Araeng. From this parched earth the nation of Nabaath Areng once rose.

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003320_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
374.description: When I journeyed here, long ago, I spoke with a sun-weathered elder.

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003330_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
375.description: He told me Amh Araeng meant “majestic land” in the language of his people.

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003340_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
376.description: And so it might still be...were it not for the Light's unrelenting onslaught...

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003350_CASSARD
381.description: Master Ghen Gen, this is the friend of the Exarch I was telling you about.

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003360_GHENGEN
382.description: Very good, very good! Though friend or no, all are welcome in Mord Souq.

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003370_CASSARD
383.description: "Souq“ is Mordish for ”city.“ As things stand, this souq boasts the largest and busiest marketplace in all Amh Araeng.

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003380_CASSARD
384.description: You'll find ore from the mines here, of course, but all manner of other things too─many of them rare.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003390_CASSARD
385.description: As I told you before, not many visit Amh Araeng by choice, but Mord Souq's a different story. Merchants come from malms around to purchase the relics the Mord dig up.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003400_GHENGEN
386.description: Aye, that they do, for Mord do not dismiss the spoils of the earth. We clean them and polish them and reveal to the world their true value!

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003410_GHENGEN
387.description: That is why they come here! Come from far away! Come with much money!

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003420_GHENGEN
388.description: And so our souq is always busy, busy, busy! No such thing as a thing no one needs!

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003430_CASSARD
389.description: You say that every time, Master Ghen Gen! Some sort of family motto, wasn't it?

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003440_CASSARD
390.description: Or perhaps a Mord philosophy─for which we should all be very grateful. Would that everyone was so willing to take in refugees regardless of race or creed.

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003450_CASSARD
391.description: Now, then─if you intend to spend any time here, you'll want to gain the trust of the locals.

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003460_CASSARD
392.description: And there's a little custom all newcomers are expected to observe...

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003470_GHENGEN
393.description: The cracking of the coinpurse! You buy one thing from the market. Price can be low or high, just as long as you buy!

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003480_CASSARD
394.description: ...As the good Mord says. In fact, the Exarch sent a little something to cover this very expense.

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003490_CASSARD
395.description: A Voeburt gold piece, no less! The first I've held in years.

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003510_MORDMERCHANTB
397.description: Here, newcomer! Crack your coinpurse with me!

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003520_MORDMERCHANTC
398.description: No, no, you want my goods, newcomer! I have jars and pots, all smooth and shiny!

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003560_GHENGEN
402.description: Enough of that! Calm, I say!

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003570_GHENGEN
403.description: This one must still journey through the barrens. Nothing bulky! Nothing heavy! No <hex:021A020203>pots<hex:021A020103>!

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003580_GHENGEN
404.description: Nothing better for the road than a full belly. Spend that piece at Rhon Ron's place, yes? Eat for three before you leave!

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003620_ALISAIE
411.description: Just a lesser sin eater. Nothing to write home about.

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003630_ALISAIE
412.description: I had it under control! ...Right up until the moment I didn't. I'll do better next time.

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003640_ALISAIE
413.description: I knew you'd turn up sooner or later, but I had been hoping for <hex:021A020203>sooner<hex:021A020103>.

415.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003660_ALISAIE
415.description: We've fought them to a standstill, then...

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003670_ALISAIE
416.description: The Exarch did say that the Empire seemed to have drawn back when he last looked in on the Source. But without knowing for sure how fast time was passing there, I couldn't help worrying that a lot might have happened since then.

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003680_ALISAIE
417.description: I'm heartily relieved to hear that it hasn't─just as Alphinaud must have been. As you can imagine, both he and Urianger were desperate to hear the news from home when I arrived.

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003690_ALISAIE
418.description: I haven't actually seen Thancred and Y'shtola yet, but they will have heard all the latest developments from the Exarch by now─or should have, at least.

419.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003700_ALISAIE
419.description: When I think of how frantic Tataru and the others must be, I want nothing more than to rush back and reassure them...

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003710_ALISAIE
420.description: But we still haven't found a way to reverse the summoning. And even if we had, we couldn't just ignore Urianger's vision.

421.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003720_ALISAIE
421.description: He may use ten words where one would suffice─and they may often obscure as much as they reveal...

422.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003730_ALISAIE
422.description: But on this matter, he was as clear as day. I do not doubt for one moment that he saw what he claims.

423.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003740_ALISAIE
423.description: Nor how difficult it must have been to speak about them. The Eighth Umbral Calamity and your death aren't exactly topics for idle conversation.

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003750_ALISAIE
424.description: As much as I might want to go home, I don't want to go home to that. We can't allow the Rejoining to happen, which means we have to save the First from the sin eaters.

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003760_ALISAIE
425.description: That great wall of white is a remnant of the Flood.

426.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003770_ALISAIE
426.description: A hundred years ago, the balance in the First tipped decisively in favor of Light. From that moment, it rose and swelled with each passing day─and then, without warning, it burst forth like water from a broken dam.

427.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003780_ALISAIE
427.description: ...A colossal wave of pure Light, drowning everything in its wake. Only Norvrandt was spared.

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003790_ALISAIE
428.description: For the most part, living things are composed of aether of various different aspects.

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003800_ALISAIE
429.description: But when exposed to such a flood, their aetheric harmony is shattered, and their natural form breaks down.

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003810_ALISAIE
430.description: Then they either perish...or are warped into mindless abominations.

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003820_ALISAIE
431.description: Yes, that's how the sin eaters came to be. They were once living creatures─or people─that were caught in the path of the Flood.

432.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003830_ALISAIE
432.description: Once the change is wrought, there is no going back. In that instant, they are gripped by an insatiable appetite for aether, and will happily gorge themselves on any living thing within reach.

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003840_ALISAIE
433.description: But even that is not the worst of it. The stronger sin eaters can plant Light in us like seeds in soil, corrupting our aether, and triggering the birth of new monstrosities.

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003850_ALISAIE
434.description: They are creatures of base instinct that exist only to feed and to multiply. They feel no pity, know no remorse, and are utterly deaf to reason. Which is why they must be destroyed. Every last one of them.

435.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003860_ALISAIE
435.description: The infirmary is full of the sin eaters' victims, left here to spend their final hours waiting for the change to overtake them...

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003870_ALISAIE
436.description: Look, over there─where the wall is broken.

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003880_ALISAIE
437.description: Do you see what lies beyond?

438.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003890_ALISAIE
438.description: That's what the land became after the Light flooded in. An empty white nothingness.

439.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003900_ALISAIE
439.description: Life cannot exist in such conditions. The primordial Light would wreak havoc on the body's aetheric balance.

440.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003910_ALISAIE
440.description: That nectarine you bought...it's Halric's favorite fruit.

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003920_ALISAIE
441.description: Most of the patients, Halric included, survived the attacks of powerful eaters.

442.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003930_ALISAIE
442.description: But their fate was sealed all the same. The monsters' corruption has entered their bodies, and their very essence is being subsumed by Light.

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003940_ALISAIE
443.description: The twisted state of the world itself just makes matters worse. Under normal circumstances, a person's aether naturally tends to equilibrium, but for these poor souls, the opposite is true.

444.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003950_ALISAIE
444.description: Sooner or later, every single one of them will turn.

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003960_ALISAIE
445.description: Tesleen and the patients, they all know this. They know what has to be done before the change goes too far─before the eater within takes over.

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003970_ALISAIE
446.description: The preferred method is mixing poison into their favorite food. In my time here, I've borne witness to a lot of last meals.

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003980_ALISAIE
447.description: I feel just as helpless as before. No matter how hard I fight, it's never enough.

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_003990_ALISAIE
448.description: But it's a war I mean to wage, nonetheless. ...Speaking of wars, do you remember how I made you promise not to leave me, and then promptly collapsed?

449.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004000_ALISAIE
449.description: Well, let's just say I had a few choice words for the Exarch concerning the timing of his summons...

450.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004010_ALISAIE
450.description: But even if the fault lay with someone else, I couldn't shake the feeling that I'd abandoned you on the battlefield.

451.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004020_ALISAIE
451.description: So I swore that I'd make up for my absence there by making a difference here.

452.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004030_ALISAIE
452.description: And that's what keeps me moving forward...even when things seem hopeless.

453.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004040_ALISAIE
453.description: On which note, it's time we headed back. The longer we keep Tesleen waiting, the harder this will be for her...

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004050_TESLEEN
454.description: Speak up if you'd like another helping. I made a little bit more than usual today.

455.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004060_ALISAIE
455.description: And you've added something special to the broth, if I'm not mistaken?

456.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004070_TESLEEN
456.description: Aye, well, it's not often we have visitors from the Crystarium, so I may have thrown in a few extra bits and bobs.

458.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_A13_000_001_NONE_VOICE
458.description: You needn't have gone to the trouble.

460.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004080_TESLEEN
460.description: Oh, it's nothing, really! And we do so rarely have guests.

461.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004090_TESLEEN
461.description: That's what I like to hear! Give me a moment to warm up the pot.

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004100_TESLEEN
462.description: In a place like this, you learn to take what moments of happiness you can get.

463.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004110_TESLEEN
463.description: I remember when I first came here with my mother. She was showing the early signs...

464.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004120_TESLEEN
464.description: I knew there was no way to save her, but I just couldn't face what needed to be done. That's the way of it for most people─why they travel for malms to stay here.

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004130_TESLEEN
465.description: Beaten, broken souls come to wait out the inevitable. To receive the mercy of a painless death.

466.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004140_TESLEEN
466.description: When my mother finally left this world, I was mad with grief, but also thankful that her passing was a peaceful one.

467.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004150_TESLEEN
467.description: It's never easy, ending a life you've cared for. Even when you believe they go on to a better place.

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004160_TESLEEN
468.description: I often find myself wishing the Warrior of Darkness would come and do that part for me.

470.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004180_TESLEEN
470.description: You've never heard the tale? I'm not sure where it began, but every child in Norvrandt could tell you a version of it.

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004190_TESLEEN
471.description: "Warrior of Darkness, servant of death,<hex:02100103>take care of our souls at our dying breath...

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004200_TESLEEN
472.description: “Let sinners and eaters of sin go with thee,<hex:02100103>That all may return to the sunless sea.”

473.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004210_TESLEEN
473.description: ...Well, that's the version I was taught anyway. It's just an old bedtime story─he's certainly never deigned to visit us here.

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004220_ALISAIE
474.description: Which is a good thing, surely? He sounds rather ominous.

475.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004230_TESLEEN
475.description: Do you think so? I always liked the idea that he treated every soul the same, even the sin eaters.

478.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004260_JOURNEYSHEADNURSE
478.description: Have you seen Halric!? I swear, I only took my eyes off him for a moment...

480.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004280_ALISAIE
480.description: No luck, then. But he surely can't have gone far.

481.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004290_ALISAIE
481.description: We should keep looking. The sin eaters are out in force, and if we don't find him soon, you can be sure they will.

482.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004300_ALISAIE
482.description: Did you see the size of that thing? It must be one of the nasty ones.

483.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004310_ALISAIE
483.description: Wherever it's going, it can only mean trouble. After it!

489.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004370_TESLEEN
489.description: We all deserve happiness...wherever we can find it...

490.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004380_TESLEEN
490.description: The time left to you...is precious... No one should die...in pain...

495.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004420_ALISAIE
495.description: Oh no, no... No, no, no, no, no!

498.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004450_MYSTERYVOICE
498.description: Have you gained a better understanding of the crisis now faced by the First?

499.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004460_ALISAIE
499.description: "Better“ is not the word I would use.

500.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004470_ALISAIE
500.description: Some lands may have been spared the Flood, but the survivors live only to suffer. There seems no end to the horrors inflicted by the sin eaters.

501.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004480_MYSTERYVOICE
501.description: Indeed. Those abominations are a calamity in their own right. And I can well imagine how hopeless the task of eradicating them must seem to you.

502.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004490_MYSTERYVOICE
502.description: But after countless battles and untold sacrifice, we have identified a potential weakness.

503.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004500_MYSTERYVOICE
503.description: Sin eaters are drawn to serve the strongest of their kind─a class of creature we call “Lightwardens.” And from what we have been able to ascertain, only a handful of these entities exist.

504.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004510_MYSTERYVOICE
504.description: Just as an ant colony will perish in the absence of its queen, we believe that the death of a Lightwarden will cause the lesser creatures within its sphere of influence to disperse.

505.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004520_ALPHINAUD
505.description: I have a feeling Eulmore might have something to say about any concerted action we take against these monsters.

506.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004530_ALPHINAUD
506.description: Vauthry's command over the sin eaters is integral to Eulmoran society. In seeming to guarantee his people's safety, it guarantees their obedience.

507.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004540_ALPHINAUD
507.description: He will not take kindly to us depriving him of such useful allies.

508.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004550_MYSTERYVOICE
508.description: Agreed. Thus we will need to occupy or otherwise divert his forces whilst we proceed with the business of eliminating the Wardens.

509.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004560_MYSTERYVOICE
509.description: Until we have done so, all other considerations must be set aside if we are to forestall the Eighth Umbral Calamity.

511.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_A14_000_001_NONE_VOICE
511.description: Are you sure that eliminating the Wardens will be enough?

513.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004570_MYSTERYVOICE
513.description: Your uncertainty is understandable, given the circumstances. Perhaps a more detailed explanation is in order. To begin at the beginning, then...

514.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004580_MYSTERYVOICE
514.description: In the ancient past, a single star was divided into fourteen worlds.

515.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004590_MYSTERYVOICE
515.description: This is the Source─your home. These others are the thirteen shards, in whose number we find the First.

516.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004600_MYSTERYVOICE
516.description: Though physically separate, they retain a connection to each other, and with the Source especially.

517.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004610_MYSTERYVOICE
517.description: Now, let us assume that a given element in one of the shards attains abnormal ascendancy.

518.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004620_MYSTERYVOICE
518.description: Just as water will flow from the highest point to the lowest, the excess energy will begin trickling into the Source...

519.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004630_MYSTERYVOICE
519.description: And such an influx of aether will of course exert a palpable influence.

520.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004640_MYSTERYVOICE
520.description: If the element in question were fire, then drought and wild fires might ensue. If it were ice, one might expect the weather to turn bitterly cold.

521.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004650_MYSTERYVOICE
521.description: As aether continues to pour in, such phenomena will become more and more extreme, until eventually, a single untimely event triggers a disaster which “cracks” the barrier dividing the two worlds.

522.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004660_MYSTERYVOICE
522.description: What was once a trickle now becomes a deluge, sweeping the shard along to be rejoined with the Source.

523.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004670_MYSTERYVOICE
523.description: At the same time, the element which held sway in the shard is unleashed in full, its energies amplifying the original disaster to truly catastrophic proportions.

524.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004680_MYSTERYVOICE
524.description: An earthquake thus magnified might strike with enough force to shatter continents; a tidal wave might swell to a size capable of drowning entire nations.

525.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004690_MYSTERYVOICE
525.description: These devastating events are what we refer to as “Umbral Calamities.”

526.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004700_MYSTERYVOICE
526.description: Seven times has a calamity befallen the Source; seven times has a shard been absorbed.

527.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004710_MYSTERYVOICE
527.description: At present, the Light-drowned realm of the First stands perilously close to meeting the conditions for a Rejoining.

528.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004720_MYSTERYVOICE
528.description: It is the sin eaters who are to blame for the Light's continued dominance.

529.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004730_MYSTERYVOICE
529.description: In addition to attracting their lesser kin, the Lightwardens I mentioned earlier radiate aether, saturating every corner of their territory with Light.

530.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004740_MYSTERYVOICE
530.description: Even here in the Flood-spared region of Norvrandt, their influence is strong enough to banish night from the sky.

531.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004750_MYSTERYVOICE
531.description: Thus, if we are to restore balance to the First and head off a potential calamity, it is imperative that we put each and every Lightwarden to the sword.

532.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004760_ALISAIE
532.description: We've been doing our best to take the fight to the enemy ever since we first heard the Exarch's explanation.

533.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004770_ALPHINAUD
533.description: Though we have yet to claim any meaningful victories, if truth be told.

534.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004780_ALPHINAUD
534.description: Apart from being confoundingly elusive, the Lightwardens possess a troublesome quality which compelled us to delay our plans until such time as you arrived.

535.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004790_LYNA
535.description: Forgive the interruption, my lord, but Holminster Switch is requesting reinforcements!

536.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004800_LYNA
536.description: They say the sin eaters are attacking in force, and the village could soon be overrun.

537.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004810_MYSTERYVOICE
537.description: Alert the guard. We should be prepared in case the fighting reaches the Crystarium.

538.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004820_MYSTERYVOICE
538.description: You have command of our forces in the field, Captain, but hold off on entering the town until I arrive. That goes for Alphinaud and Alisaie as well.

540.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004840_MYSTERYVOICE
540.description: Pray, lend us your strength. Such a fight will provide you with far greater insight than any explanation I could offer.

541.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004850_LYNA
541.description: It's releasing its aether. Fall back!

542.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004860_LYNA
542.description: We cannot let it touch us. Quickly, my lord, we must withdraw!

543.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004870_MYSTERYVOICE
543.description: That will not be necessary, Captain.

544.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004880_MYSTERYVOICE
544.description: ...Though I appreciate your concern. The eternal Light of these creatures has confounded us for nigh on a hundred years. For each we have put down, another has risen up in its place, born of the selfsame aether relinquished by its predecessor.

545.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004890_MYSTERYVOICE
545.description: But now we have a way to contain that corruption.

546.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004900_MYSTERYVOICE
546.description: The blessing of Light! And the hero who wields it now stands before you!

547.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004910_MYSTERYVOICE
547.description: The blessing of Light! And the hero who wields it now stands before you!

548.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004920_MYSTERYVOICE
548.description: Behold! The monster's power is broken! And the world twisted by its touch returns to its rightful form!

554.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004980_MOREN
554.description: The Warrior of Darkness has come!

555.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_004990_LYNA
555.description: Is that...what I think it is?

556.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005000_ALPHINAUD
556.description: The night sky, as it should be.

558.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005020_LYNA
558.description: You killed a Warden, then bathed in its aether as if it were a spring shower, and now the sky...? The legends are true!

560.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005040_MYSTERYVOICE
560.description: How many years have I waited for this moment...

561.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005050_MYSTERYVOICE
561.description: For the one possessed of Her blessing. For you.

562.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005060_MYSTERYVOICE
562.description: You have vanquished the Lightwarden of Lakeland, and for the first time in a century darkness has returned to the mantle of night.

563.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005070_MYSTERYVOICE
563.description: Without the ever-present Light to sustain them, the sin eaters will have no choice but to retreat.

564.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005080_MYSTERYVOICE
564.description: ...Yet our victory is far from complete.

565.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005090_MYSTERYVOICE
565.description: Though darkness has fallen here, the other Wardens yet bask beneath burning skies, feasting upon what little life remains.

566.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005100_MYSTERYVOICE
566.description: Even should it cost me all I have, I would see each and every one of them slain, that this world might be spared from oblivion!

567.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005110_MYSTERYVOICE
567.description: Not only for the First, but for the Source as well! Save one and we save the other! But...be that as it may...I concede it was wrong of me to summon you to this fight against your will.

568.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005120_MYSTERYVOICE
568.description: I swear on my life, I will one day atone for that deed. But for the present...

569.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005130_MYSTERYVOICE
569.description: I beg you stay and see this fight to its conclusion. Cast down the Wardens, and restore Darkness to the First!

571.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_A15_000_001_NONE_VOICE
571.description: I will become the Warrior you need.

572.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_A15_000_002_NONE_VOICE
572.description: It sounds like a glorious adventure!

573.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_A15_000_003_NONE_VOICE
573.description: It seems I've no choice but to fight.

574.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005140_MYSTERYVOICE
574.description: On behalf of the First, I offer you my deepest thanks.

575.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005150_ALISAIE
575.description: I understand there is much at stake here, Exarch, but why do you risk yourself so readily? It must have been a dangerous drain on your aether to summon even one person across the rift.

576.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005160_MYSTERYVOICE
576.description: I do it for my people, of course─to give the Crystarium the tomorrow it deserves.

577.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005170_ALISAIE
577.description: That is true <hex:021A020203>now<hex:021A020103>, yes─but the city had yet to be built when you first called forth the Crystal Tower.

578.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005180_ALISAIE
578.description: I'm simply curious to know what prompted you to commit yourself so completely to this particular course.

579.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005190_MYSTERYVOICE
579.description: There are...things which we can ill afford to lose.

580.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005200_MYSTERYVOICE
580.description: And...I sensed from the first that I had a part to play in preserving them.

581.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005210_MYSTERYVOICE
581.description: Forgive me. I fear the events of the day may have taken their toll.

582.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005220_MYSTERYVOICE
582.description: Despite appearances, I am an old man─one burdened with many...difficult memories, some too painful to recall.

583.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005230_ALISAIE
583.description: Well, then I'm sorry for pressing you. It's a family failing, I'm afraid.

584.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005240_ALPHINAUD
584.description: Hmph. One which has served us well, more often than not. Needless to say, we will continue to fight at your side until the last sin eater is defeated.

585.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005250_MYSTERYVOICE
585.description: Come then, my Warriors of Darkness─let us gather the surviving villagers, and make our way back to the Crystarium.

586.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005260_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
586.description: So it's your lot's turn to be the Warriors of Darkness, is it? It's funny how things work out.

590.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005270_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
590.description: Well, I did warn you. I followed you to Eulmore and then on to Amh Araeng. And I was there when you slew the Lightwarden.

591.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005280_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
591.description: Aye, I know. Just the place.

592.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005290_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
592.description: In case you've forgotten, you're the only one who can see me. If we had one of our little chats in public, people might start thinking you'd lost your wits.

593.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005300_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
593.description: Those white-haired twins who were with you... I remember them from our battle in the Source.

594.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005310_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
594.description: Are they your friends, then? Through thick and thin?

596.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005330_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
596.description: Then I suggest you keep them close. It's when you charge ahead trying to save someone else that you end up losing those you love.

597.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005340_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
597.description: Not that you need telling. I'll bet you've lost plenty. But I wonder...what will it cost you this time?

598.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005350_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
598.description: I don't remember when it was that I learned regret wasn't worth the bother.

599.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005360_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
599.description: You get numb to it all over the years. The lost comrades, the broken promises, the abandoned principles─just more nagging burdens to ignore.

600.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005370_RYNE
600.description: (-???-)So this is what the Light was hiding...

602.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005390_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
602.description: Meanwhile, inside an imperial magitek facility in the Source...

603.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005400_GARLEANGENERAL
603.description: (-Imperial Pilus Prior-)Intruders! Fan out and find them!

605.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005420_SHADOWHUNTER
605.description: (-???-)Stay your weapon. We are not your enemy.

606.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005430_SHADOWHUNTER
606.description: When the alarum sounded, I wondered what we had done to betray our presence. But I see now we were not the only intruders.

607.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005440_SHADOWHUNTER
607.description: Ser Estinien, I presume─the dragoon who plucked the Warrior of Light from the jaws of death. Your armor is most distinct.

608.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005450_ESTINIEN
608.description: Much as yours once was. But even without it, I see a former legatus still has eyes and ears in unexpected places.

609.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005460_ESTINIEN
609.description: "Van“ Baelsar, in the flesh. Though I understand you prefer ”Shadowhunter“?

610.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005470_SHADOWHUNTER
610.description: Hmph. You are in contact with the Scions, I take it.

611.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005480_ESTINIEN
611.description: Hmph. Through no choice of my own. They tracked me down, and conscripted me to their cause.

612.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005490_ESTINIEN
612.description: I swear their receptionist was trained as a spy. Not that anyone can escape that Baldesion woman once she has caught the scent of your aether...

613.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005500_SHADOWHUNTER
613.description: If they have resorted to using freelancers, I must assume their attempts to wake the afflicted have failed...

615.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005520_ESTINIEN
615.description: ...Away on other business. Thus it has fallen to me to root out any trace of the Empire's new weapon.

616.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005530_SHADOWHUNTER
616.description: If it is Black Rose you seek, you are too late. My people have already completed your mission here.

617.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005540_SHADOWHUNTER
617.description: Yet this is but one factory among many. When they caught wind of our efforts, they built additional facilities to ensure production continues unabated.

618.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005550_SHADOWHUNTER
618.description: There will be no one left in the lands they conquer. No citizens to conscript, no skills to exploit, nothing the Empire needs. And they will call it <hex:021A020203>victory<hex:021A020103>.

619.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005560_ESTINIEN
619.description: ...What exactly does this Black Rose do?

620.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005570_SHADOWHUNTER
620.description: The gas is described as a poison, but its actual effect is more arcane in nature.

621.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005580_SHADOWHUNTER
621.description: It was created to disrupt the aether in living beings─to bring the flow of their life energies to a standstill.

622.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005590_SHADOWHUNTER
622.description: Inhaling even the tiniest amount will cause all bodily functions to cease, much as a potent venom will stop a man's heart.

623.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005600_SHADOWHUNTER
623.description: Released over a city, Black Rose could conceivably kill every inhabitant, and all without damaging a single structure.

624.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005610_GARLEANGENERAL
624.description: (-Imperial Pilus Prior-)Search every corner! Rouse the barracks if you have to! I want this facility secured!

625.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005620_ESTINIEN
625.description: I have more questions, but now is not the time.

626.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005630_SHADOWHUNTER
626.description: Ser Estinien. I have an offer for you, but I will make it only once.

627.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005640_SHADOWHUNTER
627.description: Since it would seem we seek the same answers...you are welcome to join us.

628.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005650_ESTINIEN
628.description: Hah! From what I hear, you need all the help you can get.

629.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005660_ESTINIEN
629.description: In case you don't know, Varis himself confessed that your empire was a creation of the Ascians.

630.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005670_SHADOWHUNTER
630.description: I am aware of what His Radiance said at the parley.

631.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05000_005680_SHADOWHUNTER
631.description: Thus I would return to the capital, that I might behold the truth of this corruption with my own eyes.
